create_AddBias_module: create an AddBias nn.Module that adds a learnable bias to 2D or 4D tensors
create_Flatten_module: create a Flatten nn.Module that flattens input tensors while preserving the batch dimension
build_NNBase_recurrent: build an NNBase module with an orthogonal-initialized GRUCell for recurrent policy networks
run_NNBase_forward_gru: run the _forward_gru method to process single-step or sequence inputs through the GRU cell
review_NNBase_properties: review the NNBase is_recurrent, rec_state_size, and output_size properties for model introspection
